integrity: Analytical proof with a reproducible finite independent checker; numerical assertions do not certify infinite statements. Originality comparison based on inspected primary papers and indexed records, not independent exhaustive priority validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent continuous-time Poissonized first arrivals, identical two-speed rate profiles for two collectors, fixed positive integer groups in the rate expansion; the group-size asymptotic applies to the zero-rate derivative, not a joint limit. Older weighted ballot literature may have an equivalent identity.
title: Logarithmic susceptibility of two-speed Poissonized coupon ballot persistence
